Complete label-blind population and source hashes frozen before outcomes.
Exact u4 and keyword-only change with learner/balancer/active loop unchanged.

No label interpretation or class counts.

repair_boundary: V13 does not retry V12 or reinterpret its failed gate. It creates a new identity that repairs only the frozen canonicalizer implementation and validates the disclosed witness as public development evidence.
scientific_question: When the exact V9/V10 content-identity function is imported from its byte-bound module without reimplementation, do the two V12-frozen provider records bind the V10 population fibre, separately tie on exact u4 model text, and remain separated by provider-native keywords?

single_authorized_gate.negative_meaning: Any mismatch fails closed; no alternate pair or V13 retry.
pass_rule: All exact source, V9/V10 modules, u4 core, V12 and source-selection hashes bind.
Exactly the V12-frozen records 1003 and 1018 are read using only record_id, title, abstract and keywords.
Direct calls to the imported V9 content_identity function return the exact V10 identity for both records.
Separately constructed exact V10/u4 model-text hashes equal the frozen 77baa... value for both records.
Normalized keyword hashes and byte lengths equal the V12-frozen receipts and the hashes differ.
No label value, class count, model, ranking or performance outcome is interpreted, retained or computed.
single_authorized_gate.positive_meaning: The disclosed provider-native keyword coordinate is a byte-bound non-simulable state witness on one exact u4 text fibre within the V10 population. No performance or transport claim follows.

smallest_lawful_keyword_population.support_ceiling: With exact-u4 fallback on the three reviews lacking provider-native keywords, a keyword-only mechanism can be strictly positive on at most 4/7 reviews, below the unchanged 6/7 sign gate.
